# A Poem About Love

> apoemaboutlove.com is an open home for love poetry. It publishes original love poems, a collection of handwritten poems by founder Zachary Tye Wennstedt, a free love poem generator, a step-by-step guide to becoming a published poet, and practical guides to writing and reading love poems. Readers can submit their own love poems to be published for free. They keep their copyright, there is no payment, and publication is not guaranteed.

Key facts:
- Founder: Zachary Tye Wennstedt, a poet and painter from Colorado. His handwritten poems (2001 to 2010) are published as written, including original spelling.
- The 50 poems at /love-poems/ were written with AI and selected by editors. They are clearly labeled.
- Submissions: free, non-exclusive license, author keeps copyright, family-friendly only, no payment, no guarantee of publication.
- A poet whose poem is published on this site is a published author of that poem. apoemaboutlove.com is the publisher of the page.
- Published by Eye To Ad Media, headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

## Poems
- [50 love poems for every kind of love](https://apoemaboutlove.com/love-poems/): for her, for him, anniversary, wedding, long distance, short, sonnet, haiku, villanelle, acrostic, everyday love, love after heartbreak
- [The Notebook: handwritten love poems](https://apoemaboutlove.com/the-notebook/): poems by Zachary Tye Wennstedt, including a memorial poem for his brother
- [Founding collection and types of love poems](https://apoemaboutlove.com/): sonnet, ode, ghazal, haiku, villanelle, elegy, aubade and more, plus how to write a love poem

## Tools and guides
- [Love poem generator](https://apoemaboutlove.com/love-poem-generator/): free, runs in the browser, free verse, rhyming, haiku or acrostic
- [How to become a published poet](https://apoemaboutlove.com/how-to-become-a-published-poet/): 8-step guide, traditional vs self-publishing
- [Submit a love poem](https://apoemaboutlove.com/submit-a-love-poem/) and the [submission terms](https://apoemaboutlove.com/submission-terms/)
- [Poetry resources](https://apoemaboutlove.com/resources/)

## Blog
- [Short Love Poems for Texts and Cards (+ Write Your Own)](https://apoemaboutlove.com/blog/short-love-poems-for-texts-and-cards/): Short love poems you can copy into a text or card today, plus a simple 3-line method to write your own short love poem in five minutes.
- [What to Write in a Love Poem for Him (Not Cheesy)](https://apoemaboutlove.com/blog/what-to-write-in-a-love-poem-for-him/): Not sure what to write in a love poem for him? Use these 7 ideas, sample lines and a simple structure to write a love poem he'll actually keep.
- [What to Write in a Love Poem for Her: Ideas & Tips](https://apoemaboutlove.com/blog/what-to-write-in-a-love-poem-for-her/): How to write a love poem for her that feels personal: what to notice, sample lines, a simple structure and what to avoid.
- [Anniversary Poems by Year: Paper to Gold](https://apoemaboutlove.com/blog/anniversary-poems-by-year/): Anniversary poem ideas for every traditional anniversary gift: paper, cotton, leather, wood, tin, crystal, silver, ruby and gold, with original short poems to use.
- [How to Choose a Wedding Poem or Reading](https://apoemaboutlove.com/blog/how-to-choose-a-wedding-reading/): How to choose the right wedding poem or reading: length, tone, classic public-domain options, modern ideas, and how to read it aloud at the ceremony.
- [Long Distance Love Poems & How to Write One](https://apoemaboutlove.com/blog/long-distance-love-poems/): Long distance love poems to send across the miles, plus ideas for writing your own: time zones, countdowns and the shared moon.
- [Why the Greatest Love Poems Last: From Sappho to Dickinson](https://apoemaboutlove.com/blog/why-the-greatest-love-poems-last/): What makes a love poem last for centuries? Lessons from Sappho, Shakespeare, Donne, Browning and Dickinson you can use today.
- [How to Write a Love Haiku (With Examples)](https://apoemaboutlove.com/blog/how-to-write-a-love-haiku/): Learn how to write a love haiku in 5 steps: the 5-7-5 pattern, the seasonal image, the cut, and examples of original love haiku for every season.
- [Love Poems for Family and Friends](https://apoemaboutlove.com/blog/love-poems-for-family-and-friends/): Love poems for a mother, father, sibling or best friend: ideas, examples and the four Greek words for love behind them.
- [How to Read a Love Poem Out Loud](https://apoemaboutlove.com/blog/how-to-read-a-love-poem-out-loud/): How to read a love poem out loud at a wedding, anniversary or funeral: pacing, pauses, breathing and what to do if you cry.
